messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: pg-conn-exhaustion (high) -> paging oncall@team
incident-bot: Incident created: pg-conn-exhaustion. Summary: Postgres connection queue > 95% for service 'query-api', 5m spike. Pager: @alex.k
alex.k: acked the pager :white_check_mark:
alex.k: seeing lots of 57ms+ queue times at pgbouncer, and `ps aux` shows lots of hanging worker processes. this smells like connection pileup + slow queries.
priya: from support: customer reports intermittent 502s for real-time features. impact: ~12% of requests failing last 10m. link to graph -> https://grafana.example.com/d/ABCD/query-api?orgId=1
rashid: infra-bot: Redis evictions spike concurrently, kvcache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 43% around the same time. looks like cache stampede.
jess: any deploys in last 20m? I don't see a deploy in shipit, but there was a config push to the client SDK that rolled out 10m ago.
alex.k: running `psql -h pg-primary -c "select count(*) from pg_stat_activity where state!='idle'"` shows 380 active conns (max configured 400). pgbouncer shows `cl_active` ~ 360 and `clubs_waiting` increasing.
priya: could clients be leaking? support notes an increased retry loop from the js SDK earlier.
alex.k: mitigations: 1) enable read-only fallback for noisy route 2) scale pgbouncer pool on query-api 3) transiently increase max connections on replica 4) throttle/slowdown background jobs.
rashid: starting scale of pgbouncer service now: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy pgbouncer-query-api --replicas=4` -> running
infra-bot: pgbouncer pods 1/4 -> 4/4 scheduled. health checks passing.
alex.k: temporarily toggling client-side rate limit allowlist for internal services to reduce fanout. Priya, can you coordinate with growth about SDK rollback if needed?
priya: on it. messaging growth and support. pinging @growth-leads
jess: running quick pg kill for the top long queries:
```
SELECT pid, now() - query_start AS runtime, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active' ORDER BY runtime DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid) FROM (SELECT pid FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE now() - query_start > interval '30 seconds') t;
```
alex.k: killed ~12 stuck queries, `cl_waiting` reduced to 70. still seeing elevated error rate though.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation -> second oncall in 3m if not resolved.
priya: support-bot: customer impact note -> Public status: Degraded performance for query API endpoints; engineering investigating. Posting to status page in 2m.
rashid: Redis TTLs are high for certain keys, and eviction churn is high. suspect cache-miss storm from clients retrying. enabling local prefix cache on app nodes to reduce round trips.
alex.k: also flipping a short-term routing policy: route read-heavy traffic to read-replica pool to reduce pressure on primary. applying canary rollout.
jess: adding a temporary circuit-breaker in the service config for the heavy endpoint:
```
circuit_breaker:
  max_requests: 100
  sleep_window: 60s
```
alex.k: checklist for handoff: - stabilize connections (<50 cl_waiting) - reduce 5xx to <1% - status update to customers - plan root cause
priya: current 5xx = 9.7% -> after mitigations 3.2%
alex.k: okay, hold for 10m. if metrics keep improving we'll do full handback to normal ops.
incident-bot: Note: auto-escalation suppressed while acknowledged by @alex.k
support-bot: posted update to status page: "Investigating: degraded performance for query API. Some customers may see 502s. Working on mitigation." :loudspeaker:
jess: quick note: we saw a tiny spike in CPU on a subset of app nodes that correlate with the SDK behavioral change — might be retry loop in client.
rashid: adding an iptables rate-limit on the most chatty client IP ranges as emergency throttle (short window 5m).
alex.k: cl_waiting now 18, 5xx 0.9%, pgbouncer active down to 210 connections. Redis eviction rate stabilizing.
priya: support: PR for status update drafted, routing to comms for approval.
alex.k: preparing to hand off in 20m to night shift. leaving runbook notes and commands used.
alex.k: runbook excerpt saved -> https://confluence.example.com/display/ONCALL/pg-conn-exhaustion
incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated by @alex.k (temporary mitigations applied). will remain open until RCA.
support-bot: final public update scheduled: "Degraded service for query API mitigated; root cause investigation ongoing." :white_check_mark:
jess: adding post-incident action: add SDK throttling rules and add canary flag to config to roll out client changes slower.
priya: assigning RCA owners: @rashid (infra), @jess (app), @alex.k (oncall review).
alex.k: handing off now to @rashid for extended monitoring. leaving Slack thread pinned. good job team :thumbsup:
rashid: acked handoff. will monitor alerts and post a follow-up tomorrow with timeline and RCA notes.
support-bot: thread archived to incidents log after closure.
